title: Learning Montezuma’s Revenge from a single demonstration
summary: We’ve trained an agent to achieve a high score of 74,500 on Montezuma’s Revenge from a single human demonstration, better than any previously published result. Our algorithm is simple: the agent plays a sequence of games starting from carefully chosen states from the demonstration, and learns from them by optimizing the game score using PPO, the same reinforcement learning algorithm that underpins OpenAI Five.
body: We’ve trained an agent to achieve a high score of 74,500 on Montezuma’s Revenge from a single human demonstration, better than any previously published result. Our algorithm is simple: the agent plays a sequence of games starting from carefully chosen states from the demonstration, and learns from them by optimizing the game score using PPO, the same reinforcement learning algorithm that underpins OpenAI Five.
summaryZh: OpenAI 训练的智能体在《蒙特祖玛的复仇》游戏中取得了 74,500 分的成绩，超越了以往所有公开记录。该方法仅需单次人类演示，通过从演示中精心挑选的状态序列进行学习，并利用 PPO（近端策略优化）算法进行强化学习优化。这一成果证明了结合人类先验知识与强化学习在复杂任务中的有效性。

glossary.explanationZh: 近端策略优化，一种广泛使用的强化学习算法，以稳定性和易用性著称。
强化学习，通过奖励机制训练智能体在环境中采取最优行动的算法。
智能体，在环境中感知并采取行动以实现目标的自主系统。
